predecessors.name: British Colonial Empire
predecessors.text: the island of Grenada and its dependency of Carriacou and Petite Martinique ('two smaller islands')

ledger.x: 3 March 1967: Grenada becomes an associated state of the United Kingdom.
3 March 1967: the UK keeps external affairs and defence.
7 February 1974: independence under Eric Gairy; same state, same land.
13 March 1979: the New JEWEL Movement overthrows Gairy and sets up the People's Revolutionary Government under Maurice Bishop.
25 October 1983: the United States and Caribbean forces invade and occupy Grenada.

wars.name: United States invasion of Grenada
wars.outcome: Austin's military government was deposed; 'the first democratic elections since 1976 were held in December 1984' and won by the New National Party under Herbert Blaize.

certainty.note: Island coasts; the maritime boundary with Saint Vincent and the Grenadines in the Grenadines is not given on the pages opened.
